hypothesis: The failed aggregate NBM blend has an actionable, temporally stable city-bias mechanism rather than diffuse incremental underperformance: at least six cities have same-direction material median-to-winner residuals in development and validation, and the three worst validation cities account for at least 50% of positive challenger excess log loss.

data_policy.included: PRICE_ELIGIBLE development and validation dates from EXP-20260908-us-nbm-quantile-calibration-v1

diagnostics.signed_median_to_winner_interval_distanc: zero inside winning bucket; negative below its finite lower bound; positive above its finite upper bound; zero when forecast lies in the open direction of a tail
diagnostics.stable_city_bias: development and validation mean signed distances have the same nonzero sign and development absolute mean is at least 1F
diagnostics.excess_loss: challenger multiclass log loss minus market multiclass log loss
diagnostics.concentration: three largest positive city validation excess-loss totals divided by total positive city excess-loss

go_no_go.go: Permit one low-capacity city-offset challenger preregistered before touching test.
go_no_go.no_go: Do not build city-specific NBM model; keep test untouched and pivot away from this NBM branch.
